subject: Pilot bridge request while PO completes
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@helixmed.com>, ops+procurement@helixmed.com
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 27 May 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Pilot bridge request while PO completes

Hi Sara (and procurement team),

Quick note on the Helix pilot: the team has been using Redwood for the last two weeks and adoption metrics look promising (attached usage summary). I understand the PO is in the procurement queue and finance/legal need to finish a couple of items before it can be issued.

We'd like to offer a short bridge so your engineers don't lose continuity — would a 7-day provisional credit window work while the PO clears? If so we can provision a token bucket and keep the environment live. We typically request a quick email confirmation from procurement so we have a paper trail for the outbound credit.

Numbers for context: the pilot has consumed ~18k tokens/day over the last 7 days. A 7-day buffer at current usage would be ~126k tokens. If you need a smaller window, tell me what makes sense.

Next steps:
- Let me know if procurement can confirm they want a short bridge (reply or put us on a PO no later than the bridge end date)
- If approved, I’ll coordinate with our billing lead to provision the provisional credit and share terms

Attachment: pilot-usage-summary.csv

Thanks,
Mateo
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0112

From: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@helixmed.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ops+procurement@helixmed.com
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pilot bridge request while PO completes

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for the note and the usage summary — looks good. Quick update from our side: legal pushed the contract review to next week and procurement flagged a vendor onboarding item that needs a brief compliance check. The internal estimate is ~10 business days before the PO is finalized.

We absolutely don’t want to lose the environment; the engineering leads are mid-integration. A 7-day bridge would help but given the 10-business-day estimate, could you offer up to two weeks? I can escalate internally but want to be realistic about timelines.

If you can provide provisional access for 14 days and we send an email confirmation from procurement within that window, that would be ideal.

Thanks — Sara
Senior Product Manager, Helix Medical
sara.jenkins@helixmed.com
+1 (617) 555-0220

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@helixmed.com>
Cc: ops+procurement@helixmed.com
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 11:00:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pilot bridge request while PO completes

Sara —

Appreciate the update and the realistic timeline. We can provision a provisional credit for 14 days while your PO completes, subject to internal approval on our end. I’ve attached a short provisional-credit-terms PDF that outlines the conditions (non-refundable, applied to post-PO invoice or forfeited if no PO arrives within the window).

Before I escalate for approval, could procurement confirm they’re comfortable sending a one-line email (ops+procurement@helixmed.com) confirming they expect to issue a PO for Redwood within the 14-day window? That confirmation is all we need from your side to move forward quickly.

If procurement prefers, we can require a signed acknowledgement via DocuSign — tell me what’s easiest.

Regards,
Mateo
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: provisional-credit-terms.pdf

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 09:07:00 -04:00
Subject: Internal: approval request — provisional 14-day credit for Helix Medical (DEAL-78321)

Karthik / Ben,

Helix Medical (DEAL-78321) is asking for a provisional 14-day credit while their PO clears (legal/compliance hold estimated ~10 business days). Current pilot usage ~18k tokens/day. They requested full 14 days; I suggested the same and attached usage summary + provisional terms.

Proposed provisional package: 200k token credit (covers expected usage + small buffer)
Estimated realized cost to Redwood at our marginal rate: ~$120 (very small)
Business rationale: keep momentum on technical integration, prevent trial abandonment, likely to convert to reserved capacity if the pilot goes well. Procurement has agreed to send a confirming email during the credit window as our acceptance condition.

Can you confirm we can approve this credit under standard commercial exceptions? I’ll log the approval in HubSpot and add the provisional terms doc to the deal.

Thanks,
Mateo

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Internal: approval request — provisional 14-day credit for Helix Medical (DEAL-78321)

Mateo —

Approved. Provision 200k token credit (label: PROV-HELIX-0626), window = 14 days starting on provisioning timestamp. Require procurement’s one-line confirmation (ops+procurement@helixmed.com) in thread or a signed DocuSign if they prefer.

Please:
- Provision credit and update HubSpot (DEAL-78321) with the credit id and terms link
- Attach provisional-credit-terms.pdf to the deal record
- If procurement doesn’t confirm inside the window, let billing know to mark the credit as forfeited and close the loop with the customer

Good call on keeping the integration live — low cost, high likelihood of conversion.

Ben
